title: The Bermuda Triangle Disappearances
hook: Since the early 1900s dozens of vessels have vanished within the Bermuda Triangle. The lack of wreckage leaves the mystery unsolved.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In the early 1900s dozens of ships vanished within the Bermuda Triangle

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The 1918 loss of the USS Cyclops a 187-meter cargo ship sparked mystery

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: In December 1945 Flight 19's five Avenger bombers disappeared after radio contact failed

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: A 1948 rescue plane reported strange lights and a sudden engine failure over the sea

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent analysis suggests strong Gulf Stream currents and human error explain many disappearances but some cases remain unexplained

end.line: What hidden factor could still be lurking beneath the waves?

description: Explore the mysterious disappearances of ships and planes in the Bermuda Triangle.

facts.claim: The USS Cyclops vanished in March 1918 with 309 crew members
Flight 19 disappeared on 5 December 1945 over the Atlantic
The Bermuda Triangle is bounded by Miami, Bermuda, and Puerto Rico
Gulf Stream currents in the area can reach up to 2.5 m/s
A 2020 study in the Journal of Navigation linked many incidents to human error and environmental factors
